# mimalloc provenance

Squashed MIT-licensed subtree from [microsoft/mimalloc v3.5.0](https://github.com/microsoft/mimalloc/tree/18b08671c9302247bfb682286e6bf3cc1773f801). Update `native/third_party/mimalloc` with a squashed subtree pull. The native build generates symbol prefixes and audits the production object. Run that audit after an update.
